input.rationale: Executing the registered discriminator for the commit-eligibility question. The harness builds one process with two real Voters (quorum 2) plus one real Nonvoter that is fully caught up, then withholds each side in turn and reports the leader's own last log index, the leader's commit index and the nonvoter's last log index as independent operands, so the comparison does not depend on the apply result alone. Native construction feedback (same inputs, same package, executed locally before submission) produced: mode A with the Nonvoter withheld - apply completed, leader_last_index=4, leader_commit=4, nonvoter_last_index=3; mode B with a Voter withheld - the apply future returned 'leadership lost while committing log', leader_last_index=5, nonvoter_last_index=5 (the nonvoter stored the entry) while leader_commit stayed 4. Those operands are the decisive ones: a nonvoter acknowledgement did not advance commitIndex, and commits proceeded with a withheld nonvoter. The submission records the fixed experiment for controller execution; the measured interpretation is deliberately left for the retained receipt rather than claimed from the native run.

scope.description: One process: bootstrapped two-Voter cluster (quorum 2) plus one real Nonvoter added with AddNonvoter while fully connected, then two withheld-side cases in the same execution. Case A withholds the Nonvoter's transport and applies one command; case B reconnects everyone, withholds a Voter's transport and applies one command. Each case emits the leader's last log index, the leader's commit index and the nonvoter's last log index, plus whether the apply future completed inside an 800ms window and its error.

experiment.prefix: MakeCluster(2) bootstraps the two Voters and waits for a leader; MakeClusterNoBootstrap(1) creates the Nonvoter with an empty log; Merge plus FullyConnect wire all three transports so the Nonvoter is reachable and can store entries. The leader calls AddNonvoter(id, address, 0, 0) and the test waits 300ms so the nonvoting configuration is committed and the Nonvoter's log has caught up (baseline records leader_last_index=3, nonvoter_last_index=3). Isolation uses the cluster's transport-level Disconnect on the withheld node's address, which removes it in both directions without modifying production logic; FullyConnect restores it. Observability uses the package-internal getLastIndex/getCommitIndex accessors on the real raft objects, so the operands are the runtime state of the objects under test rather than a derived label.

scope.description: Two-voter in-process cluster over InmemTransport, plus one real unbootstrapped raft instance merged into the same network; call AddVoter for the new server on the current leader, record the future result and index, then sample each node's reported configuration every 100ms for 3s.

basis.prefix: MakeCluster(2) starts a bootstrapped pair and waits for a leader; MakeClusterNoBootstrap(1) creates the new node with empty log and no configuration; Merge and FullyConnect wire the transports so the new node is reachable but has an empty log. The leader calls AddVoter(newID, newAddr, 0, 0) with prevIndex 0. Observations are the AddVoter future result/index and, per node, num_servers/num_voters/has_new_member sampled from the node's locally reported configuration, emitted as CA_EVENT JSON.

result.summary: Submitted the fixed mixed-suffrage experiment for the commit-eligibility question: one process with two real Voters (quorum 2) plus one fully caught-up real Nonvoter, applying one command while the Nonvoter is withheld and one while a Voter is withheld, emitting the leader's last log index, the leader's commit index and the nonvoter's last log index as independent operands. Native construction feedback with identical inputs showed mode A committing with the Nonvoter withheld (leader_commit 3->4) and mode B leaving leader_commit at 4 while the Nonvoter had stored entry 5 and the apply returned 'leadership lost while committing log', i.e. a nonvoter acknowledgement did not advance commitIndex; the measured interpretation is left for the retained controller receipt. Added supporting sources for commitment.match plus the replication/quorum/lease voter-only sets.
